findings.summary: C1: adminConfirmBooking/adminCancelBooking used findById then accessed lazy booking.getUser()/getTour() in sendBookingNotification — LazyInitializationException risk. Fixed: replaced with findByIdWithTourAndUser (eager fetch).
C2: application-prod.properties had no broker config — prod boot would fail if AMQP/JMS starters present. Fixed: added env-var-backed ActiveMQ + RabbitMQ blocks.
C3: setTrustAllPackages(true) allowed deserialization of any class via JMS — security risk. Fixed: replaced with setTrustedPackages(List.of(messaging.activemq, entity packages)).
M1: @Modifying on markAllReadByUserId lacked clearAutomatically=true — stale L1 cache after bulk update. Fixed: added clearAutomatically=true.
M2: Test ActiveMQ URL was vm://localhost without broker.persistent=false — could leave disk residue. Fixed: added broker.persistent=false query param.

R1: update() used tourRequest.getStatus() (may be null) instead of saved.getStatus() for publishIfActive — suppressed notification on no-status-field updates. Also: no transition guard — any ACTIVE update re-broadcast to all users. Fixed: capture previousStatus before setStatus(); only publish on non-ACTIVE → ACTIVE transition.

R2: RabbitMQ listeners had no error handling; defaultRequeueRejected=true causes infinite hot-loop on any exception. Fixed: declared DLX + DLQs in RabbitMQConfig; listeners throw AmqpRejectAndDontRequeueException on failure.

R3: Broker messages sent inside @Transactional before DB commit — notification delivered even if transaction rolls back. Fixed: replaced direct producer/publisher calls with ApplicationEventPublisher.publishEvent(); @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) dispatchers handle actual send.
R4: saveAll() with IDENTITY strategy = N individual INSERT round-trips; all user IDs loaded into memory first. Fixed: replaced with native INSERT...SELECT — one statement, zero entity loading.

R5: Custom ActiveMQConnectionFactory bean caused Boot auto-config back-off, bypassing CachingConnectionFactory; spring.jms.* properties ineffective. Fixed: removed custom factory + JmsTemplate beans; moved trusted-packages to spring.activemq.packages.trusted property.
